2364-4779-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2364-4779-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Mana Vault, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

3430-3755-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

549-5413-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5413-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-5413-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

3363-8188.notablePrerequisites: Salvage Scuttler doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3363-8188.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Return The One Ring to your hand using Salvage Scuttler.
Repeat each turn.

1395-5078-6968-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-2511-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2511-4616.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

147-1893-3899.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1893-3899.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4694-4802-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-4802-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
4694-4802-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2921-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2921-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4636-5770-6753-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7324.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jennika, adding {C}{C}.
When Jennika dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Jennika from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Jennika enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1115-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1115-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1414-2866-4986-6797.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

5686-6010--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

856-1477-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1018-2792-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
1018-2792-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Skullwinder and Great Whale, targeting Skullwinder
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Great Whale.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Skullwinder and Great Whale tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1251-2933-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

3192-4050-5532.easyPrerequisites: "Legion" chosen with Battle of Hoover Dam.
3192-4050-5532.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3192-4050-5532.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {1}.
When the creature dies, Battle of Hoover Dam triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Ulasht.
Activate Ulasht's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
3192-4050-5532.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Ulasht, you may target any other creature with Battle of Hoover Dam's trigger instead.

1329-2210-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrormade is a copy of Genesis Chamber.
Enough additional mana and/or artifacts on the battlefield to make up for Emry's command tax (if applicable).
1329-2210-3169-4050.description:
Cast Emry by paying {U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
When Emry enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, Genesis Chamber, and the copy of Genesis Chamber.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve Emry's ability, milling four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Send Emry from the graveyard to the command zone as a state-based action.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times.

3933-4565-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4565-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

3356-4831-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
3356-4831-5358.description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible, if needed.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G}, causing a Polyraptor and Cacophodon to fight each other.
Polyraptor and Cacophodon trigger twice.
Resolve both Polyraptor triggers, creating two token copies of it.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping Wayta and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

423-511-3510-4365.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4365.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
When the Saprolings enter the battlefield as Forest lands due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers twice, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

486-4853-4917-5147.description:
Activate Liquimental Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Construct token.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

2011-2557-4076.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-2557-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
